name: Israel, Gaza & region
value: Gaza raids; Beqaa strike 20 Nov; Houthi fire
summary: Israeli fire in Gaza and a Beqaa strike on 20 Nov; Houthi missiles fired at Riyadh on 10 Nov
state: Gaza authorities reported one Palestinian killed and 13 injured in Israeli attacks on 20 Nov, after an Israeli ground offensive west of the Yellow Line in mid-November (Middle East Monitor; Al Jazeera, 18 Nov). Israel said it struck a site in Lebanon's Beqaa on 20 Nov that it alleged Hezbollah was rebuilding for missile production; no casualties were reported (AP via Daily Waadaa). Saudi Arabia intercepted Houthi missiles fired at Riyadh on 10 Nov (Al Jazeera). Hostilities on several fronts keep the Alert.
for_you: Follow FCDO travel advice for Israel, the Palestinian territories, Lebanon, Yemen and Saudi Arabia.
